EelsAcquisitionSettings.description: Exposure settings for the acquisition. Must contain at least one element.

EelsSpectrumImageSettings.name: eels_detector
EelsSpectrumImageSettings.description: The name of the EELS detector. Enumeration EelsDetectorType can be used.

EelsSpectrumImageSettings.name: eels_exposure_settings
EelsSpectrumImageSettings.description: Exposure settings for the acquisition. Must contain exactly one element.

EelsSpectrumImageSettings.name: dwell_time
EelsSpectrumImageSettings.description: Scan dwell time in seconds. When not provided, the value is calculated from the exposure times.

EelsSpectrumImageSettings.name: size
EelsSpectrumImageSettings.description: Square image size in pixels. Enumeration ImageSize can be used.

EelsSpectrumImageSettings.name: scanning_detectors
EelsSpectrumImageSettings.description: The name(s) of the STEM detector(s). Enumeration DetectorType can be used.

EelsSpectrumImageSettings.name: scanning_detector_segments
EelsSpectrumImageSettings.description: The detector segment(s) used for the acquisition.

RunOptiStemSettings.name: method
RunOptiStemSettings.description: Specifies what OptiStemMethod should be used. The default value is C1A1.

RunOptiStemSettings.name: dwell_time
RunOptiStemSettings.description: STEM dwell time in seconds. The default value depends on method.

RunOptiStemSettings.name: cutoff_in_pixels
RunOptiStemSettings.description: Interval between any two adjacent samples - Nyquist interval in pixels. The default value is 4 pixels. This parameter is not used for B2A2 method and will result in exception if set.

RunOptiStemSettings.name: cutoff_spatial_frequency
RunOptiStemSettings.description: Amount of cycles per meter. The default value is 2.85e+9. This parameter is not used for B2A2 method and will result in exception if set.

RunOptiStemResults.name: quality
RunOptiStemResults.description: Evaluation of the resulting tuning procedure quality. Uses values from ResultQuality.

RunImageCorrectorSettings.name: phase_contrast_transfer_function_target_g_max_inverse
RunImageCorrectorSettings.description: Value of 1/g_desired of the PCTF [m]. Represents the smallest intended spatial detail to be transferred with good contrast.

RunImageCorrectorSettings.name: phase_contrast_transfer_function_target_phase_sign
RunImageCorrectorSettings.description: Target phase type of the phase contrast transfer function. Uses values from RunImageCorrectorTargetPhaseSignType.

RunImageCorrectorResults.name: quality
RunImageCorrectorResults.description: Evaluation of the resulting tuning procedure quality. Uses values from ResultQuality.

RunProbeCorrectorSettings.name: probe_semi_aperture_angle
RunProbeCorrectorSettings.description: Probe semi aperture angle [rad]. Half of the opening (convergence) angle of the electron probe with respect to the specimen plane with a given condenser aperture for STEM imaging.

RunProbeCorrectorSettings.name: probe_current
RunProbeCorrectorSettings.description: Electrical current of the electron probe [A].

RunProbeCorrectorResults.name: quality
RunProbeCorrectorResults.description: Evaluation of the resulting tuning procedure quality. Uses values from ResultQuality.

RunProbeCorrectorResults.name: probe_optimum_d50
RunProbeCorrectorResults.description: Theoretical optimum diameter of the electron probe that contains 50% of the intensity, calculated for a perfectly aligned system (no correctable aberrations remaining) [m]. This is the calculated limit of the intended resolution.

RunProbeCorrectorResults.name: probe_total_d50
RunProbeCorrectorResults.description: Measured diameter of the electron probe that contains 50% of the intensity [m]. This is the actual limit of the intended resolution. A well-tuned corrector will show a Total D50 that approaches the Optimum D50 value.

RunBeamCenteringSettings.name: maximum_allowed_distance
RunBeamCenteringSettings.description: The maximum allowed distance from the desired position in meters. Default value is 0.

RunBeamCenteringSettings.name: target_position
RunBeamCenteringSettings.description: Target position as a unitless 2D vector (x, y). (0, 0) is the centered position on the optical axis, (1, 1) is top right, (-1,-1) is bottom left.

RunBeamCenteringSettings.name: maximum_iterations
RunBeamCenteringSettings.description: The maximum number of beam-center iterations.

RunBeamCenteringSettings.name: beam_diameter_change_allowed
RunBeamCenteringSettings.description: If True, the alignment is allowed to change the diameter of the beam. Beam diameter is restored to initial when the ResultQuality is 'Bad' or when execution fails.

RunBeamCenteringSettings.name: stage_movement_allowed
RunBeamCenteringSettings.description: If True, the alignment is allowed to move the stage. Stage position is restored to initial when the ResultQuality is 'Bad' or when execution fails.

RunBeamCenteringSettings.name: check_only_mode
RunBeamCenteringSettings.description: Runs the procedure in CheckOnly mode to retrieve the value of the aligned parameter. The Alignment is not executed in CheckOnly mode.

RunBeamCenteringResults.name: quality
RunBeamCenteringResults.description: Procedure's result quality. Uses values from ResultQuality.

RunBeamCenteringResults.name: off_center_distance
RunBeamCenteringResults.description: The beam centering offset from final to target position in meters.

RunBeamCenteringResults.name: message
RunBeamCenteringResults.description: Optional message regarding the result of the alignment.

RunApertureCenteringSettings.name: aperture_mechanism_type
RunApertureCenteringSettings.description: The type of the aperture mechanism to be centered. Uses values from ApertureMechanismType. Currently only C2 is supported.

RunApertureCenteringSettings.name: maximum_allowed_distance
RunApertureCenteringSettings.description: The maximum allowed distance from the desired position in meters. Default value is 0.

RunApertureCenteringSettings.name: aperture_names
RunApertureCenteringSettings.description: A collection of apertures to be centered. When empty, only the currently selected aperture is centered.

RunApertureCenteringSettings.name: maximum_iterations
RunApertureCenteringSettings.description: The maximum number of aperture-center iterations.

RunApertureCenteringSettings.name: beam_diameter_change_allowed
RunApertureCenteringSettings.description: If True, the alignment is allowed to change the beam's diameter.

RunApertureCenteringSettings.name: stage_movement_allowed
RunApertureCenteringSettings.description: If True, the alignment is allowed to move the stage.

RunApertureCenteringSettings.name: check_only_mode
RunApertureCenteringSettings.description: Runs the procedure in CheckOnly mode to retrieve the alignment's execution state. Procedure is ready to run when the state is 'execute'. The Alignment is not executed in CheckOnly mode.

RunApertureCenteringResults.name: quality
RunApertureCenteringResults.description: Procedure's result quality. Uses values from ResultQuality.

RunApertureCenteringResults.name: off_center_distances
RunApertureCenteringResults.description: The centering offsets the target position for each aperture in meters.

RunApertureCenteringResults.name: message
RunApertureCenteringResults.description: Optional message regarding the result of the alignment.

CenteringResult.name: off_center_distance
CenteringResult.description: The offset from the target position in meters.

Variant.name: value
Variant.description: Returns the value of the variant as a boolean, float, int, or string.

RunRotationCenterAlignmentSettings.name: maximum_number_of_iterations
RunRotationCenterAlignmentSettings.description: The maximum number of rotation center alignment iterations.

RunRotationCenterAlignmentResults.name: quality
RunRotationCenterAlignmentResults.description: Procedure's result quality. Uses values from ResultQuality.

RunRotationCenterAlignmentResults.name: message
RunRotationCenterAlignmentResults.description: Optional message regarding the result of the alignment.

ContinuousCameraAcquisitionSettings.name: buffer_size
ContinuousCameraAcquisitionSettings.description: Number of frames saved in the acquisition buffer, 1 by default.

ContinuousCameraAcquisitionSettings.name: buffer_type
ContinuousCameraAcquisitionSettings.description: Type of the acquisition buffer. Uses values from AcquisitionBufferType. Default is CIRCULAR.

ContinuousCameraAcquisitionSettings.name: frame_rate
ContinuousCameraAcquisitionSettings.description: The acquisition frame rate in frames per second. Limits maximal exposure time. Default is the maximum frame rate for the given CameraAcquisitionSettings.

ContinuousScanSettings.name: buffer_size
ContinuousScanSettings.description: Number of frames per detector or segment saved in the acquisition buffer, 1 by default.

ContinuousScanSettings.name: buffer_type
ContinuousScanSettings.description: Type of the acquisition buffer. Uses values from AcquisitionBufferType. Default is CIRCULAR.

ContinuousScanSettings.name: synchronization_type
ContinuousScanSettings.description: Type of the synchronization. Uses values from ScanSynchronizationType. Default is NONE.

exclusions.service.simulator: Simulator control is not instrument metrology.
exclusions.service.offline: Offline service is not a real microscope.
exclusions.service.toolkit: Toolkit service is not an optical readback.
exclusions.analysis: Acquisition streams and jobs, not passive machine parameters.
exclusions.state: Saved state / APT experiments are not live optical readbacks.
Requires a caller-supplied key; SDK provides no key enumerator.
exclusions.methods: Only explicitly implemented enumerators and read methods are invoked.
